with date_range as (
    select (select d_date_sk from date_dim where d_date = '2000-08-19') as start_dss,
           (select d_date_sk from date_dim where d_date = '2000-09-02') as end_dss
),
ssr as (
    select s_store_id, 
           sum(nvl(ss_ext_sales_price, 0)) as sales,
           sum(nvl(sr_return_amt, 0)) as returns,
           sum(nvl(ss_net_profit, 0)) as store_sales_profit,
           sum(nvl(sr_net_loss, 0)) as store_returns_net_loss
    from (
        select ss_store_sk as store_sk, 
               ss_sold_date_sk as date_sk, 
               ss_ext_sales_price as sales_price, 
               ss_net_profit as profit, 
               cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as return_amt, 
               cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as net_loss
        from store_sales
        where ss_sold_date_sk between (select start_dss from date_range) and (select end_dss from date_range)
        union all
        select sr_store_sk as store_sk, 
               sr_returned_date_sk as date_sk, 
               cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as sales_price, 
               cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as profit, 
               sr_return_amt as return_amt, 
               sr_net_loss as net_loss
        from store_returns
        where sr_returned_date_sk between (select start_dss from date_range) and (select end_dss from date_range)
    ) salesreturns
    join store on store_sk = s_store_sk
    where date_sk between (select start_dss from date_range) and (select end_dss from date_range)
    group by s_store_id
),
csr as (
    select cp_catalog_page_id, 
           sum(nvl(cs_ext_sales_price, 0)) as sales,
           sum(nvl(cr_return_amount, 0)) as returns,
           sum(nvl(cs_net_profit, 0)) as store_sales_profit,
           sum(nvl(cr_net_loss, 0)) as store_returns_net_loss
    from (
        select cs_catalog_page_sk as page_sk, 
               cs_sold_date_sk as date_sk, 
               cs_ext_sales_price as sales_price, 
               cs_net_profit as profit, 
               cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as return_amt, 
               cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as net_loss
        from catalog_sales
        where cs_sold_date_sk between (select start_dss from date_range) and (select end_dss from date_range)
        union all
        select cr_catalog_page_sk as page_sk, 
               cr_returned_date_sk as date_sk, 
               cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as sales_price, 
               cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as profit, 
               cr_return_amount as return_amt, 
               cr_net_loss as net_loss
        from catalog_returns
        where cr_returned_date_sk between (select start_dss from date_range) and (select end_dss from date_range)
    ) salesreturns
    join catalog_page on page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk
    where date_sk between (select start_dss from date_range) and (select end_dss from date_range)
    group by cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr as (
    select web_site_id, 
           sum(nvl(ws_ext_sales_price, 0)) as sales,
           sum(nvl(wr_return_amt, 0)) as returns,
           sum(nvl(ws_net_profit, 0)) as store_sales_profit,
           sum(nvl(wr_net_loss, 0)) as store_returns_net_loss
    from (
        select ws_web_site_sk as wsr_web_site_sk, 
               ws_sold_date_sk as date_sk, 
               ws_ext_sales_price as sales_price, 
               ws_net_profit as profit, 
               cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as return_amt, 
               cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as net_loss
        from web_sales
        where ws_sold_date_sk between (select start_dss from date_range) and (select end_dss from date_range)
        union all
        select wr_web_site_sk as wsr_web_site_sk, 
               wr_returned_date_sk as date_sk, 
               cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as sales_price, 
               cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) as profit, 
               wr_return_amt as return_amt, 
               wr_net_loss as net_loss
        from web_returns
        where wr_returned_date_sk between (select start_dss from date_range) and (select end_dss from date_range)
    ) salesreturns
    join web_site on wsr_web_site_sk = web_site_sk
    where date_sk between (select start_dss from date_range) and (select end_dss from date_range)
    group by web_site_id
)
select channel , id , sum(sales) as sales , sum(returns) as returns , sum(profit) as profit 
from (
    select 'store channel' as channel , 'store' || s_store_id as id , sales , returns , (store_sales_profit - store_returns_net_loss) as profit 
    from ssr 
    union all 
    select 'catalog channel' as channel , 'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id as id , sales , returns , (store_sales_profit - store_returns_net_loss) as profit 
    from csr 
    union all 
    select 'web channel' as channel , 'web_site' || web_site_id as id , sales , returns , (store_sales_profit - store_returns_net_loss) as profit 
    from wsr 
) x 
group by rollup (channel, id) 
order by channel ,id
